prompt: You can invite only six people to a birthday meal because of cost, and two other close friends will hear about it and likely feel left out. What is the most honest and considerate approach?

options.text: Invite who you can, tell the others honestly before photos appear online that numbers were limited by cost not by worth, and arrange a separate catch-up with them
Tell the others there is no meal happening, then post photos from it anyway
Invite everyone anyway and hope the venue squeezes you in, even though you will resent the cost
Uninvite the friend least likely to complain to make room for the others, after already promising them a place

explanation: Honesty before they hear it second-hand respects their feelings and separates the cost limit from how much you value them. Lying, overspending resentfully, or breaking a promise to someone else creates bigger hurts.
